description: This file contains performance tests for UDP socket write operations, including setup, execution, and benchmarking for blocking and non-blocking modes within the Chromium network codebase.

classes.name: UDPSocketPerfTest
classes.description: Performance test class for UDP socket write benchmarking, supporting both blocking and non-blocking modes.

methods.name: WritePacketsToSocket
methods.description: Sends a specified number of UDP packets through the socket, invoking a callback upon completion.

methods.name: WriteBenchmark
methods.description: Performs the UDP socket write performance test, measuring elapsed time and write speed.
